mapper.insert: insert into group_buy_order_list( user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, start_time, end_time, goods_id, source, channel, original_price, pay_price, deduction_price, status, out_trade_no, biz_id, create_time, update_time ) values( #{userId}, #{teamId}, #{orderId}, #{activityId}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{goodsId}, #{source}, #{channel}, #{originalPrice}, #{payPrice}, #{deductionPrice}, #{status}, #{outTradeNo}, #{bizId}, now(), now() )
mapper.select: select user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, start_time, end_time, goods_id, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, pay_price, status from group_buy_order_list where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and user_id = #{userId}
select count(id) from group_buy_order_list where user_id = #{userId} and activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.update: update group_buy_order_list set status = 1, out_trade_time = #{outTradeTime}, update_time = now() where out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 0
mapper.select: select out_trade_no from group_buy_order_list where team_id = #{teamId} and status = 1
select user_id, team_id, out_trade_no from group_buy_order_list where activity_id = #{activityId} and user_id = #{userId} and status in (0, 1) and end_time > now() order by id desc limit #{count}

select user_id, team_id, out_trade_no from group_buy_order_list where activity_id = #{activityId} and team_id in (select team_id from group_buy_order where activity_id = #{activityId} and status = 0) and user_id != #{userId} and status in (0, 1) and end_time > now() order by id desc limit #{count}
select user_id, team_id, out_trade_no from group_buy_order_list where activity_id = #{activityId} and status in (0, 1) group by team_id
mapper.update: update group_buy_order_list set status = 2, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and order_id = #{orderId} and status = 0
update group_buy_order_list set status = 2, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and order_id = #{orderId} and status = 1
update group_buy_order_list set status = 2, update_time = now() where user_id = #{userId} and order_id = #{orderId} and status = 1
mapper.select: select user_id, team_id, order_id, activity_id, start_time, end_time, goods_id, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, pay_price, status, out_trade_no, out_trade_time, source, channel from group_buy_order_list where status = 0 and out_trade_time is null and now() > end_time limit 10

select o.user_id, o.order_id, o.out_trade_no, o.goods_id, s.goods_name, s.main_image, o.activity_id, o.team_id, o.source, o.channel, o.original_price, o.deduction_price, o.pay_price, o.status as order_status, o.out_trade_time, o.create_time, o.update_time, t.status as team_status, t.target_count, t.complete_count, t.lock_count, t.valid_end_time from group_buy_order_list o left join group_buy_order t on t.team_id = o.team_id left join sku s on s.goods_id = o.goods_id
order by o.id desc limit #{offset}, #{pageSize}

select user_id, order_id, out_trade_no, goods_id, activity_id, team_id, source, channel, original_price, deduction_price, pay_price, status as order_status, out_trade_time, create_time, update_time from group_buy_order_list where team_id = #{teamId} order by id asc
select count(id) from group_buy_order_list where activity_id = #{activityId}
